topSignals.title: FERC suspends PJM's 6 GW data-center backstop auction for five months; PJM pulls its Sept 30 launch.
topSignals.text: On Sept 29, FERC accepted but suspended PJM's Reliability Backstop Procurement, setting a new effective date of Feb 28, 2027, pending refund and further proceedings — citing unresolved issues on cost allocation, transmission-owner exit rules, and load-serving-entity collateral requirements. FERC Chair Laura Swett said PJM "filed at the last minute," leaving no time "to rehabilitate the mess we received." PJM consequently canceled the auction that was due to open Sept 30 and run through Oct 21 (reported as "now live" in yesterday's digest — this reverses that status); a new timeline is "yet to be determined" per a PJM spokesman. This directly resets the nearest-term test case for how PJM values behind-the-meter/on-site generation, including SOFC, relative to grid alternatives. Utility Dive, mgrid.org

topSignals.title: Priority stack check — Elcogen and Topsoe both quiet again (now 4th/5th straight day).
topSignals.text: Direct checks of Elcogen's news page confirm nothing posted since the Sept 23 SOEC whitepaper and Sept 21 Metrosert cooperation; Topsoe's press-release feed likewise shows nothing dated to the last 24-48h. Elcogen News, Topsoe News

topSignals.title: Otherwise a broad quiet day.
topSignals.text: Extended English/German searches across deployments, competing on-site power, market/financials, research, and LCOE datapoints turned up nothing new beyond the PJM/FERC story. The regulatory calendar for October now carries one less fixed point (PJM auction date open-ended) alongside the still-scheduled German EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket hearings (Oct 5/7), KWK-Gesetz cabinet date (Oct 14), and Bloom Energy's Q3 earnings (Oct 27).

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet — no new stack/cell, capacity, or partnership news beyond the already-logged Sept 21 (Metrosert) and Sept 23 (SOEC whitepaper) items; confirmed via direct page check. Elcogen News
Topsoe (priority): Quiet — official news/press-release pages checked directly; no SOEC/SOFC, capacity, or partnership items dated to the last 24-48h. Topsoe News
Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin: no new stack/cell-technology announcements found in the window.

New — see Top Signal #1:* FERC suspended PJM's 6 GW data-center capacity backstop procurement for five months (new effective date Feb 28, 2027) on cost-allocation, transmission-owner-exit, and collateral grounds; PJM pulled the Sept 30 auction launch and has no confirmed new date. Offer cap of $555/MW-day was approved; the ~6,831 MW procurement scope itself was not rejected, only delayed pending PJM's corrective filing. Utility Dive
No change* on the EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket Redispatch-Vorbehalt track: committee hearings Oct 5 (EEG) / Oct 7 (Netzpaket), final vote targeted around Oct 16.
No change* on Germany's KWK-Gesetz (CHP law): cabinet consideration remains scheduled for Oct 14.

No change* in the last 24-48h on: DOE/FERC large-load interconnection rulemaking (Apr 30, 2026 deadline); ITC 48E (30% fuel-cell credit) and 45V hydrogen credit; Virginia data-center electricity tax, New York permit moratorium, Texas development pause, EPA turbine NSPS; California's seven data-center bills signed Sept 21 — all as previously logged.
Bloom Energy (BE): No new operational or financial disclosures in the window. Q3 earnings due Oct 27.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No new operational disclosures in the window; Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline (Fit Energy cost-overrun disclosure suit) still pending; backlog remains $3.6B per the Q3 transcript.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new market-moving news in the window.

lcoe.text: No new cost, efficiency, capex/opex, or gas/H2/electricity price datapoint published in the last 24-48h beyond already-logged items (Pan et al. $3.49/kg LCOH; Kourougianni et al. >30% annualized-cost reduction for rSOC+PV; Sept 25 EIA Henry Hub summer-2026 average of $2.93/MMBtu).

New (regulatory-risk context, not a cost figure): The PJM backstop auction's indefinite delay (new effective date Feb 28, 2027 if refiled successfully) removes the near-term October data point on how PJM-territory capacity markets would price behind-the-meter/on-site SOFC generation versus batteries and other fast-deploy assets — worth noting as a timing risk for any PJM-territory revenue-stacking assumptions in the model, not as a hard number.

Pending calendar (updated): PJM backstop procurement — new effective date Feb 28, 2027, resubmission timeline TBD; German EEG/Netzpaket committee hearings Oct 5 (EEG) / Oct 7 (Netzpaket), final vote targeted Oct 16; German KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration Oct 14; Bloom Q3 earnings Oct 27; FCEL lead-plaintiff deadline Nov 10; New Mexico air-quality permit deadline for Project Jupiter Nov 23.
